item.title: Towerborne Review
item.description: Nusrat from NoobFeed writes: The game can be played by itself, but Towerborne is clearly made to be played with other people. Players can work together online up to four times. Combat becomes more interesting and lively when everyone works together. Another player might focus on high-damage targets while the first player handles the crowds. In rewarding ways, abilities overlap.

item.title: The Legend of Khiimori Review | NoobFeed
item.description: Mahi from NoobFeed writes: The Legend of Khiimori will feel slow if you want a fast, open world with fights all the time and scripted drama that never ends. This is one of the most serious attempts to make a horse game that doesn't treat the horse like a motorcycle with fur. If Aesir can deliver good performance, easy controls, and a wide range of content at the Early Access launch on March 3, 2026, it has a good chance of becoming more than just a fun experiment.
